verdict.rationale: Superhuman's docs say it automatically reminds you to follow up when your email needs a response, with a draft ready, which covers the follow-up-reminder half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents snoozing conversations. The evidence also never confirms that a thread is resurfaced in the inbox when nobody replies, or how reminder timing is configured. missing for 10: snooze conversations capability, explicit thread-resurfacing behavior on no-reply, user-configurable reminder timing, independent/hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: If your email needs a response, you’re automatically reminded to follow up—with a draft already written and ready to send.
Get an email assistant that automatically labels incoming emails, archives low-priority messages, drafts replies, and reminds you to follow up.
keeps every follow-up on track, all inside Gmail or Outlook.
